newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end mostly higher.

text.p: June 27 - U.S. stock index futures ended mostly higher, though off the day's peaks. Sept S&P 500s pushed to 905.00 amid technical momentum and buystops, but stalled there. It slowly cut gains all afternoon and closed below key 900.00. Traders look ahead to heavy U.S. line-up next week, including FOMC, June jobs, NAPM, Independence day holiday. Nasdaq down.
